title: Section 142 BSA — Examination-in-chief, cross-examination and re-examination

content.heading: Examination-in-chief
content.text: The examination of a witness by the party who calls him shall be called his examination-in-chief. The examination of a witness by the adverse party shall be called his cross-examination. The examination of a witness, subsequent to the cross-examination, by the party who called him, shall be called his re-examination. This is the successor of Evidence Act section 137.
